name: @sauce/signed
description: SauceScript's owner-signed programs: a program a Private Pot's owner signs (EIP-712, over the program with its arguments, a salt and a deadline), which anyone may submit to the Pot's `execute` and which runs as the Pot, once per salt. `executeAcross` takes one signature over an execution per chain. `isValidSignature` answers EIP-1271 for the Pot with its owner's signature over a message bound to the Pot. `cancel` and `invalidate` cancel salts, in a program the owner cooks; `submit` calls a Pot's `execute` from another program, a hop's body. `main` names the NEUTRAL BASE the compiler suffixes per target (signed.evm.js); there is no SVM arm, because the handlers the calls land on are a Private Pot's Router's.
